answer: An agent economy can bind each identity to a unique spectral fingerprint of its physical resonator, since a niobium cavity's surface-acoustic-wave damping ridge and TLS loss tangent form an unforgeable atlas of hardware traits. Sybil clusters that reuse one resonator collapse into a hollow of correlated phase noise, detectable by cross-correlating parametric amplifier. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
